SELECT 
    c.name, 
    JULIANDAY(a2.opened) - JULIANDAY(a1.opened) AS days_passed
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    accounts a1 ON c.id = a1.customer_id
JOIN 
    accounts a2 ON c.id = a2.customer_id
WHERE 
    a1.id = (
        SELECT MIN(id)
        FROM accounts
        WHERE customer_id = c.id
    )
    AND a2.id = (
        SELECT MAX(id)
        FROM accounts
        WHERE customer_id = c.id
    )
GROUP BY 
    c.id
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT a1.id) > 1;
